title: Receipted delivery: an unpromoted receipted prompt removed from the queue loses its receipt silently instead of settling Rejected
outcome: Receipted delivery: an unpromoted receipted prompt removed from the queue loses its receipt silently instead of settling Rejected
acceptance: A receipted prompt that leaves the queue before its hand-off began (Stop, Cancel, source clear) ends with a terminal Rejected receipt that the settled-limit prune ages out, or the wire contract documents the removal semantics explicitly
A test removes an unpromoted receipted prompt by each removal path and asserts the chosen terminal behaviour
